commentary_summary: The Handysize tonne-miles index surged 11% QoQ in 3Q25, supported by seasonal firmness. Laden speed increased in accordance. Port congestion also rose 10.8% MoM in the west, reducing the share of vessels underway. | Laden tonnage at anchor increased across both East and West, driving momentum in spot rates, which continued on a strong upward trajectory. | Strength in the Atlantic and Indian Ocean underpinned sentiment, while the Pacific market remained comparatively subdued and positional.
